c.v: Instead of CTS/RTS lines, software flow control uses XON/XOFF characters to start or stop data transmission.
Such flow control can be enabled by setting

When choosing software flow control, the hardware automatically detects if XON and XOFF characters are used in the data flow, and generates a UART_SW_XOFF_INT or a UART_SW_XON_INT interrupt accordingly.
When XOFF character is detected, the transmitter stops data transmission once the current byte has been transmitted; when XON character is detected, the transmitter starts data transmission.
